task: T12 multi-horizon stacking with meta-learner (Ridge / LR / LightGBM)

diagnosis.explanation: Meta absorbs class-1 (no-move) prior, becomes 6-10x more conservative than base; threshold cannot reach +21.86 because not enough confident predictions remain.

notes: iter_002 base h_10 (T=0.55, d=0.10) +21.86 is uncatchable by post-softmax stacking. Meta loses 4-5 pnl mainly via conservatism on folds 0/3/4. Best meta strategy is essentially raw argmax (T=0.35 d=0). R12 'completely free' multi-horizon stacking does not transfer to this base model. Base h_10 trained on 223-d raw features is already exploitative enough that 15-d post-softmax meta cannot match.
